description: Call one documented DELETE operation of the DCAST Partner API v1 (https://api.dcast.pro/api/v1); what it deletes is gone. The arguments are checked against the operation's contract first; a mismatch is answered with the exact problems and howToFix and NOTHING is sent. Runs with the connected user's own access: permission, plan limits and rate limits are the API's. Deleting needs the delete permission granted on the DCAST consent screen. Other methods are refused here: GET goes to dcast_read_operation, POST/PUT/PATCH to dcast_call_operation.

args.description: { path?: {param: value}, query?: {name: value}, body?: {...} } as in dcast_describe_operation callWith

name: dcast_delete_operation
title: Delete through the DCAST API
